data.name: Name
data.provider_cloudflare_workers_ai_clear: Cloudflare Workers AI — Clear saved credentials
data.write_metadata: Write a .json file with the generation metadata

data_description.provider: Preferred provider, tried first. If it fails, configured providers with valid credentials are tried in sequence. Paid providers may incur charges.
data_description.provider_pollinations_account: Informational only; not sent to the API.
data_description.provider_pollinations_api_key: Optional: without a key, Pollinations is only used when selected as the preferred provider.
data_description.provider_cloudflare_workers_ai_account: Required for Cloudflare Workers AI; find the account ID in your Cloudflare dashboard.
data_description.provider_cloudflare_workers_ai_api_key: Required. Workers AI has a free daily allocation subject to Cloudflare limits.
data_description.provider_google_gemini_account: Informational only; not sent to the API.
data_description.provider_google_gemini_api_key: Required. Free availability depends on the Google AI Studio model and plan.
data_description.provider_huggingface_account: Informational only; not sent to the API.
data_description.provider_huggingface_api_key: Required. Hugging Face Inference may require paid credits or a paid plan.
data_description.provider_openai_compatible_account: Informational only; not sent to the API.
data_description.provider_openai_compatible_api_key: Sent as a bearer token when provided; endpoint costs depend on its service.
data_description.provider_openai_compatible_base_url: Required to configure this endpoint; costs depend on the service.
data_description.update_interval: How often both images are regenerated.
data_description.output_dir: Absolute path inside Home Assistant. Anything under /config/www is reachable at /local/...
data_description.retention_mode: Overwrite: only the current file. Keep last N: archives the previous versions and keeps the newest N. Keep for N days: archives and deletes anything older.
data_description.keep_count: Only used by the 'Keep last N' policy.
data_description.keep_days: Only used by the 'Keep for N days' policy.
data_description.history_subdir: Subfolder of the output folder where old versions are archived. Leave empty to archive next to the current file.
data_description.stagger_seconds: Anonymous Pollinations usage is limited to about one request every 15 seconds.
data_description.negative_template: How the negative words are merged into the prompt. Placeholders: {prompt} and {negative}.
data_description.generate_on_start: Disable if you prefer to wait for the first scheduled run.

data_description.filename: The current image always keeps this name, so dashboards can use a stable URL.
data_description.negative_prompt: Comma separated words to avoid. They are appended to the prompt because Pollinations has no dedicated negative prompt parameter.
data_description.model: Choose a model supported by the selected provider. Gemini uses Gemini image models; Hugging Face requires a model ID available through Inference Providers.
data_description.seed: -1 means a new random seed on every run; a fixed value gives reproducible results.
data_description.quality: Only honoured by gptimage, gptimage-large and gpt-image-2.
data_description.reference_image: Optional. Used by editing/img2img models such as kontext, nanobanana and seedream.
data_description.width: Requested size. Backends refuse sides below 512px, so a larger image is generated and then resized down.
data_description.height: Requested size. Backends refuse sides below 512px, so a larger image is generated and then resized down.
data_description.exact_size: Crop/resize the picture so the saved file matches the width and height above exactly (needs Pillow).
data_description.fit: cover crops to fill, contain adds white bars, stretch distorts.
data_description.output_format: auto follows the file extension (a .png file really contains PNG). Pollinations always returns JPEG, so pick PNG for ESPHome online_image.
data_description.color_mode: grayscale and black & white (dithered) produce much smaller files for e-ink panels.
data_description.bw_levels: Only used when Colour mode is 'bw': number of Floyd-Steinberg dithered gray shades (2 = pure black/white).
